provenance: RuboCop 1.89.0 CLI / Parser 3.3.12.0; recorded 2026-10-25. Parser regressions with the platform Layout/EndOfLine cop disabled on both tools; all other default-enabled cops, independent CLI per target/ending/mode. Reports and on-disk reference bytes are preserved. Candidate writeback keeps the original LF/CRLF format under the existing intentional divergence.
